messages.subject: testing a random effect (Batch)
parts:
hey i am trying to test if a specific random effect (Batch) is significant, so i built to models one includes this random effect and one without it.
this is my code: 
#male=0, Female=1, mutant=1, control=0#
library(nlme)
Genotype<-c(rep(1,14),rep(0,14))
Gender<-c(rep(1,7),rep(0,7),rep(1,7),rep(0,7))
Batch<-rnorm(28,mean=0,sd=1)
y<-vector(mode="numeric", length=28)
for(i in 1:28)
{
  y[i]<-3+2*Genotype[i]+3*Gender[i]+5*(Genotype[i]*Gender[i])+Batch[i]+rnorm(1)
}

testing_batch<-function(dataset,depVariable)
{
 
  model.formula <- as.formula(paste(depVariable, "~", paste("Genotype", "Gender", "Genotype*Gender", sep= "+")))
  
  model_withbatch=do.call("lme", args = list(model.formula, random=~1|Batch, dataset, na.action="na.omit", method="REML"))
  model_withoutbatch=do.call("gls", args=list(model.formula, dataset, na.action="na.omit"))
  p.value=(anova(model_withbatch, model_withoutbatch)$p[2])/2
  keep_batch= p.value<0.05
  return(keep_batch)
}
testing_batch(y,y)

i am getting this error:
Error in eval(predvars, data, env) : 
  numeric 'envir' arg not of length one

how can i fix this?
